description: This Java interface defines a repository for accessing WidgetTypeInfoEntity data from a SQL database, with multiple custom queries for filtering widget types based on various criteria such as tenant ID, search text, resource links, and widget bundle associations.

classes.name: WidgetTypeInfoRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for WidgetTypeInfoEntity with custom SQL queries for widget type filtering and retrieval.

methods.name: findSystemWidgetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of system widget types filtered by tenant ID, search text, and other criteria.

methods.name: findAllTenantWidgetTypesByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tenant widget types filtered by tenant ID, search text, and other criteria.

methods.name: findTenantWidgetTypesByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of widget types for a specific tenant ID with filtering options.

methods.name: findWidgetTypesInfosByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Finds widget type info entities associated with a specific widget bundle ID.

methods.name: findByTenantAndImageUrl
methods.description: Finds widget type info entities by tenant ID and image URL with a limit.

methods.name: findByImageUrl
methods.description: Finds widget type info entities by image URL with a limit.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeInfosByTenantIdAndResourceLink
methods.description: Finds widget type info entities by tenant ID and resource link, returning EntityInfo objects.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeInfosByResourceLink
methods.description: Finds widget type info entities by resource link, returning EntityInfo objects.
